title: Show ideation phase in webuu
description: The we you doesn't show the ideation phase at all
plan:
## What

Show ideation phase content in the web UI dashboard. The ideating stage section already appears in the board view (it's in the stage order), but when users click on a feature card in the ideating stage, the modal does not display ideation-related content. Additionally, the feature cards in the dashboard board view don't carry ideation data attributes, so there's nothing to display even if the modal tried.

## Why

Users managing features through the ideation/debate phase need to see ideation summaries and debate content directly in the web dashboard. Without this, they must use the TUI or inspect JSON files to understand what happened during ideation. This creates a gap in the web UI's ability to serve as a complete project management interface.

## Scope

**In scope:**
- Add ideation and ideation_summaries data attributes to feature cards in the dashboard board_fragment template
- Display ideation content in the showFeature() modal when a user clicks a feature card (matching the pattern already used in client.html)
- Show ideation summaries (debate round outputs) as a collapsible/scrollable section in the modal

**Out of scope:**
- Adding ability to trigger or manage ideation rounds from the web UI (that's a separate feature)
- Changes to the client.html template (it already has ideation display)
- Changes to the Go backend/API (FeatureSummary already has the fields, and they're already serialized)
- Adding a 'Move for Debate' button to the dashboard (separate feature request exists for this)

## Impact

- The dashboard board_fragment template needs two new data attributes on feature cards
- The showFeature() JavaScript function needs a new section for rendering ideation content
- No backend changes needed - the data is already flowing through the WebSocket state updates
- No changes to the data model or API endpoints
- Minimal risk of breaking existing functionality since this is purely additive HTML/JS

## Risks

- Ideation summaries can be lengthy (multiple debate rounds). The modal needs to handle potentially large content gracefully without breaking the layout.
- The ideation_summaries field is an array of strings. Need to render each round distinctly so users can follow the debate progression.
- Data attribute encoding: ideation summaries may contain special characters, quotes, or newlines that need proper HTML attribute escaping (the existing escapeAttr template function handles this).
plan_exploration_summary: Explored the MAD web UI server code (Go + embedded HTML templates). Key files: server/api.go (routing, stageOrder, groupFeaturesByStage), server/hub.go (FeatureSummary struct with Ideation/IdeationSummaries fields), server/templates/index.html (dashboard board_fragment template and showFeature modal), server/templates/client.html (client detail view with ideation rendering). Found that 'ideating' IS in stageOrder (api.go:19), so the stage section renders in the dashboard. However, the board_fragment template in index.html does NOT include data-ideation or data-ideation-summaries attributes on feature cards, and the showFeature() JavaScript modal does NOT render ideation content. By contrast, client.html already has ideation display logic (lines 851-856) and passes data-ideation (line 1227). The .mad/boards/mad/ideating/ directory exists with 6 feature files. The FeatureSummary Go struct already has Ideation and IdeationSummaries fields (hub.go:55-56).
test_spec: # Test Specification: Show Ideation Phase in Web UI ## 1. Behaviors That MUST Be Verified ### 1.1 Feature cards in board_fragment carry ideation data attributes **Behavior:** When the dashboard board_fragment template renders feature cards, each card element must include `data-ideation` and `data-ideation-summaries` attributes populated from the FeatureSummary struct. **Success criteria:** - A feature card for an item with a non-empty `Ideation` field has a `data-ideation` attribute whose value matches the ideation content (HTML-attribute-escaped via `escapeAttr`). - A feature card for an item with populated `IdeationSummaries` (e.g., two debate round strings) has a `data-ideation-summaries` attribute whose value is a valid JSON array of strings (encoded via `toJSON`). - A feature card for an item with empty `Ideation` and nil/empty `IdeationSummaries` has `data-ideation=""` and `data-ideation-summaries="[]"` (or `"null"`). **Expected output:** The rendered HTML of the board_fragment contains the two new data attributes on every feature-card div, regardless of whether the values are populated. ### 1.2 cardHash() includes ideation attributes for change detection **Behavior:** The `cardHash()` JavaScript function must include `data-ideation` and `data-ideation-summaries` in the hash string so that WebSocket state updates reflecting ideation changes trigger a board refresh. **Success criteria:** - Two cards that differ only in `data-ideation` produce different hash values. - Two cards that differ only in `data-ideation-summaries` produce different hash values. - Two cards with identical attributes (including ideation) produce the same hash value. **Expected output:** Hash strings that include ideation data, pipe-delimited, appended after the existing attributes. ### 1.3 showFeature() modal displays ideation content **Behavior:** When a user clicks a feature card that has a non-empty `data-ideation` attribute, the modal must render an "Ideation" section showing the ideation text. **Success criteria:** - The modal HTML contains a section labeled "Ideation" (uppercase). - The ideation text is displayed with `white-space: pre-wrap` to preserve formatting. - The ideation text is escaped via `escapeHtml()` before insertion into the DOM (XSS safety). - The ideation section appears after the description section and before the history section. **Expected output:** A styled div with the ideation content, matching the existing dashboard modal styling patterns (colors #8b949e for label, #c9d1d9 for content, border-top #21262d). ### 1.4 showFeature() modal displays ideation summaries (debate rounds) **Behavior:** When a user clicks a feature card that has a populated `data-ideation-summaries` attribute (JSON array of strings), the modal must render an "Ideation Summaries" section with each round numbered. **Success criteria:** - The section header reads "Ideation Summaries (N rounds)" where N is the array length. - Each debate round is displayed with a "Round X" label (1-indexed). - Each round's text content is escaped via `escapeHtml()`. - The summaries container has `max-height: 300px` and `overflow-y: auto` to handle lengthy content. - Round labels use color #d2a8ff (purple, matching existing styling for emphasis). **Expected output:** A scrollable container with numbered rounds, each showing the debate summary text. ### 1.5 Ideation section hidden when no ideation data exists **Behavior:** When a feature card has empty ideation data, the modal must NOT render an ideation section or ideation summaries section. **Success criteria:** - If `data-ideation` is empty string, no "Ideation" header appears in the modal. - If `data-ideation-summaries` is `[]` or `null`, no "Ideation Summaries" header appears in the modal. - The modal otherwise renders normally (description, history, reviews, etc.). **Expected output:** Modal HTML with no ideation-related sections. ## 2. Edge Cases ### 2.1 Empty/null ideation fields - Feature with `Ideation: ""` and `IdeationSummaries: []` — no ideation sections rendered in modal. - Feature with `Ideation: ""` and `IdeationSummaries: nil` — no ideation sections rendered; JSON parse of null should not throw. - Feature with non-empty `Ideation` but empty `IdeationSummaries` — only the "Ideation" section renders, no "Ideation Summaries" section. - Feature with empty `Ideation` but non-empty `IdeationSummaries` — only the "Ideation Summaries" section renders, no "Ideation" section. ### 2.2 Special characters in ideation content - Ideation text containing HTML special characters (``) — must be escaped, not executed. - Ideation text containing double quotes, single quotes, and backticks — must not break the HTML attribute or JavaScript rendering. - Ideation text containing newlines (`\n`) and tabs (`\t`) — must be preserved in display via `white-space: pre-wrap`. - Ideation summaries containing JSON-special characters (backslashes, nested quotes) — the `toJSON` template function must encode them safely, and `JSON.parse` must decode them correctly. ### 2.3 Large content - Ideation summaries with 10+ debate rounds — all rounds render, container scrolls. - Individual summary text exceeding 5000 characters — renders within the scrollable container without breaking modal layout. - Combined ideation + summaries content larger than all other modal sections — the 300px max-height on summaries prevents the modal from becoming unusably tall. ### 2.4 Malformed data - `data-ideation-summaries` attribute containing invalid JSON — the `try/catch` around `JSON.parse` must prevent a JavaScript error; the summaries section simply doesn't render. - `data-ideation-summaries` attribute containing a JSON object instead of array — should not crash; the `.length` check or iteration should gracefully skip rendering. ### 2.5 Feature cards across different stages - A feature in the "ideating" stage with ideation data — ideation sections render in modal. - A feature in a later stage (e.g., "implementing") that still has historical ideation data — ideation sections still render (data is preserved across stage transitions). - A feature in the "ideas" stage with no ideation data — no ideation sections rendered. ## 3. What Constitutes Failure ### 3.1 Missing data attributes - FAIL if a rendered feature card in the board_fragment does not have both `data-ideation` and `data-ideation-summaries` attributes present in the HTML. ### 3.2 XSS vulnerability - FAIL if ideation text containing HTML tags is rendered as actual HTML rather than escaped text.
